The way of peace they have not known, and there is no justice in their tracks. They have turned them into crooked paths; no one who treads on them will know peace.

targetPassage.text: “Their feet are swift to shed blood; ruin and misery lie in their wake, and the way of peace they have not known.”

sourcePassage.text: “The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression, ” declares the LORD.

targetPassage.text: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.

sourcePassage.text: “As for Me, this is My covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit will not depart from you, and My words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth or from the mouths of your children and grandchildren, from now on and forevermore,” says the LORD.

targetPassage.text: And this is My covenant with them when I take away their sins.”

sourcePassage.text: When You did awesome works that we did not expect, You came down, and the mountains trembled at Your presence.

targetPassage.text: Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”

sourcePassage.text: “I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me; I was found by those who did not seek Me. To a nation that did not call My name, I said, ‘Here I am! Here I am!’

targetPassage.text: And Isaiah boldly says: “I was found by those who did not seek Me; I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me.”

sourcePassage.text: All day long I have held out My hands to an obstinate people who walk in the wrong path, who follow their own imaginations,

targetPassage.text: But as for Israel he says: “All day long I have held out My hands to a disobedient and obstinate people.”

sourcePassage.text: This is what the LORD says: “Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me? Or where will My place of repose be?

targetPassage.text: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me, says the Lord, or where will My place of repose be?

sourcePassage.text: Has not My hand made all these things? And so they came into being,” declares the LORD. “This is the one I will esteem: he who is humble and contrite in spirit, who trembles at My word.

targetPassage.text: Has not My hand made all these things?’

sourcePassage.text: “As they go forth, they will see the corpses of the men who have rebelled against Me; for their worm will never die, their fire will never be quenched, and they will be a horror to all mankind.”
